thread:
ravi: quick spike: proposing a compact 'Fallback Explain' panel on rollout pages. needs to answer three questions fast: why, when, who.
hana: Love that. Also include the exact rule id + the signal snapshot that triggered it (p95, error_rate, quota_remaining). Small sparkline helps.
service-bot: service-bot: canary deploy 0.25.0 rolled out to staging :white_check_mark:
ravi: UX constraints: keep PII out. show hashed request ids and an option to expand sanitized context if admin toggles it.
ops-sam: How about replay? We should offer a dry-run that replays decision logic against a recorded context, not live models. Output: simulated route + cost delta + audit note.
hana: Yup. Also need cooldown/hysteresis visible. If a rule triggered, show cooldown remaining and reason (avoid flip-flop).
ravi: Minimal inspector layout (read-only): Decision summary, Trigger details (table), Operator actions (overrides + revert), Replay (dry-run), Audit link/export CSV.
hana: Example policy snippet for UI (read-only):
```json
{
  "policy": "fallback-ltg-01",
  "triggers": [
    {"metric": "latency_p95_ms", "op": ">", "value": 1200},
    {"metric": "error_rate", "op": ">", "value": 0.05}
  ],
  "action": {"type": "route", "target": "lite-quantized-v1", "ttl_min": 5, "cooldown_min": 3}
}
```
ops-sam: For quotas: precedence should be explicit in the panel. propose: operator > maintenance > quota > perf > error > reject. Make it configurable per rollout.
hana: Retention: default 90 days for decision records, with org-level override to 365. expose export for compliance.
ravi: Follow-ups: API to fetch decision snapshots (/rollouts/{id}/decisions?since=...), retention UI in org admin, mock screenshots and replay sandbox scope. I'll attach mocks in next thread.
ops-sam: Thanks — tag me for the mock review.
